findings.title: Nearness becomes embodied attendance

findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 92:17:1:3 carries the near-side branch; 92:19:3 supplies presence at something and 92:20:3 supplies facing. Their contact turns an abstract relation of rescue into a spatially legible arrangement around the protected person.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the promised separation as a change in position and relation: a person is placed at a side, held in presence, and oriented before a face, while the ordinary rescue reading remains in view.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-bounded contextual resonance, not a surah-wide system and not a claim of kinship or ownership. The channel source is a first-pass nomination without maturity adjudication; an opposing turning-away reading at 92:16 remains live in the packet.
